## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Include a before/after example
when useful. Use a Conventional Commit PR title for the default squash merge.

## Specification and decisions

Link the relevant specification and ADRs, or explain why this is a routine change
that does not need them. Identify compatibility or migration requirements.

## Verification

List checks actually executed and their results. State any checks that could not
run and why. New PMD/frontend advisory findings require review, not blanket suppression.

## Review and release considerations

Describe material risks, UI evidence when useful, and any manual deployment or
rollback steps. Merging this PR does not deploy to the production VM.
